114.objectiveText: Take the Invisibility Liquor to Maybell Maclure.

397.objectiveText: Speak with Zggi, the servant of Zardeth the Blackclaw, to claim your reward.

650.objectiveText: Talk to Gilveradin Sunchaser; his camp is located in the Hinterlands.

697.objectiveText: Take the Sealed Letter to Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

773.objectiveText: Travel to Red Rocks east of Thunder Bluff and speak with the Ancestral Spirit.

775.objectiveText: Speak with Cairne Bloodhoof in Thunder Bluff.

784.objectiveText: Kill 10 Kul Tiras Sailors, 8 Kul Tiras Marines and Lieutenant Benedict and return to Gar'Thok in Razor Hill.

786.objectiveText: Lar Prowltusk outside of Sen'jin Village wants you to destroy the 3 sets of Attack Plans held within Kolkar Crag.

819.objectiveText: Find someone who knows about Chen's Empty Keg.

823.objectiveText: Speak with Orgnil Soulscar in Razor Hill.

849.objectiveText: Destroy the flying machine at Bael Modan and return to Gann Stonespire.

851.objectiveText: Bring Verog's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

852.objectiveText: Bring Hezrul's Head to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

855.objectiveText: Bring 15 Centaur Bracers to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads.

865.objectiveText: Gather 5 Intact Raptor Horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, and bring them to Mebok Mizzyrix in Ratchet.

869.objectiveText: Bring 12 Raptor Heads to Gazrog at the Crossroads.

871.objectiveText: Of the Razormane tribe, kill 8 Water Seekers, 8 Thornweavers and 3 Hunters, and then return to Thork in the Crossroads.

882.objectiveText: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.

884.objectiveText: Bring Owatanka's Tailspike to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.

885.objectiveText: Bring Washte Pawne's Feather to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

890.objectiveText: Bring Gazlowe's Ledger to Wharfmaster Dizzywig.

913.objectiveText: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.
